title: Intambwe zikurikira
subtitle: Hagaragara gusa intambwe itsinda rikwitaho ryakwemereye.
error: Ntitwashoboye kubona intambwe zawe zikurikira. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
refreshHint: Kurura hasi urebe niba hari intambwe zavuguruwe
acknowledgeHint: Bimenyesha itsinda rikwitaho ko wasomye iyi ntambwe. Ntibihindura intambwe.
acknowledgedAnnounce: Byabitswe. Wagaragaje ko wasomye iyi ntambwe.
ackError: Ntitwashoboye kubika ibi. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.

conflict.title: Iyi ntambwe yavuguruwe
conflict.body: Itsinda rikwitaho ryavuguruye iyi ntambwe. Soma verisiyo iheruka.

datePassed: Itariki y'iyi ntambwe yarenze. Itsinda rikwitaho rizakuvugisha, cyangwa ushobora kuribaza.
toChangeContact: Kugira ngo uhindure ibi, vugana n'itsinda rikwitaho.
noAdvice: Agasanduku kerekana gusa ibyo itsinda rikwitaho ryemeje. Ntigatanga inama z'ubuvuzi.
supportHint: Ifungura Ibindi, aho uburyo bw'ubufasha buri

empty.title: Nta ntambwe zikurikira urasangizwa
empty.body: Itsinda rikwitaho ntirirasangiza intambwe zikurikira. Niba wabwiwe kugaruka, rivugishe.

contact.title: Vugana n'itsinda rikwitaho
contact.callHint: Yerekana nimero ya telefoni y'igerageza. Ntihamagara.
contact.sheetBody: {{phone}} ni nimero y'igerageza. Ntihuza n'umurongo nyawo wa telefoni, bityo agasanduku ntikayihamagara.
contact.unavailable: Amakuru yo kuvugana n'aha hantu ntaboneka muri iri gerageza.

detail.title: Intambwe ikurikira
detail.denied: Iyi ntambwe ntiri mu makuru ushobora kureba.
